"];
const STORY_WIDTH=1536,STORY_HEIGHT=1024;
const STORY_SCENES={
 opening:{label:'ВТОРНИК · 09:00',art:STORY_ART[0],rects:[[8,32,505,962],[524,32,488,962],[1021,32,506,962]]},
 lunch:{label:'ПОГОНЯ ЗА ОБЕДОМ · 11:45',art:STORY_ART[1],rects:[[12,15,987,485],[1012,15,512,485],[12,517,702,493],[729,516,795,494]]},
 win:{label:'МИССИЯ ВЫПОЛНЕНА',art:STORY_ART[2],rects:[[9,9,1518,500],[9,529,721,486],[743,528,784,487]]},
 lose:{label:'СЕГОДНЯ НЕ МОЙ ДЕНЬ',art:STORY_ART[3],rects:[[9,8,1518,497],[8,529,751,485],[774,529,753,485]]}
};
let storyIntroSeen=false,storyStage=null,storyStep=-1,storyFrames=[],storyAutoTimer=null,storyDone=null;
let storyPageResizeObserver=null;
function storyClearTimer(){if(storyAutoTimer!==null){clearTimeout(storyAutoTimer);storyAutoTimer=null;}}
function storyFitPage(){
 const holder=$('storyPageWrap'),page=$('storyPage');if(!holder||!page)return;
 const w=holder.clientWidth,h=holder.clientHeight;if(w<=0||h<=0)return;
 const pw=Math.max(1,Math.min(w,h*1.5));
 page.style.width=Math.floor(pw)+'px';page.style.height=Math.floor(pw/1.5)+'px';
}
function storyCropImage(img,rect){
 const [x,y,w,h]=rect;
 img.style.width=(STORY_WIDTH/w*100)+'%';img.style.height=(STORY_HEIGHT/h*100)+'%';
 img.style.left=(-x/w*100)+'%';img.style.top=(-y/h*100)+'%';
}
function storyRefreshControls(){
 const scene=STORY_SCENES[storyStage];if(!scene)return;
 const count=scene.rects.length;
 $('storyCount').textContent=String(Math.max(0,storyStep+1)).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+String(count).padStart(2,'0');
 [...$('storyProgress').children].forEach((el,i)=>el.classList.toggle('on',i<=storyStep));
 $('storyNext').textContent=storyStep===count-1?(storyStage==='opening'?'▶ НАЧАТЬ ИГРУ':storyStage==='lunch'?'▶ ИГРАТЬ ДАЛЬШЕ':'★ НА РЕКОРД'):'ДАЛЬШЕ ›';
}
function storySchedule(ms){
 storyClearTimer();if(!storyStage||document.hidden)return;
 storyAutoTimer=setTimeout(()=>{storyAutoTimer=null;storyAdvance();},ms);
}
function storyStop(){
 storyClearTimer();storyStage=null;storyDone=null;storyFrames=[];
 $('storyCinematic').hidden=true;lunchSceneActive=false;
}
function storyFinish(){
 if(!storyStage)return;
 const finishedStage=storyStage,finishedCallback=storyDone;
 storyStop();
 if(finishedStage==='lunch')setMsg('ГОНКА В «ЧАО»! Осталось 20 покупателей. Набери '+LUNCH_GOAL+' очков до 100-го!');
 if(finishedStage==='win'||finishedStage==='lose'){
   lunchEndless=true;
   refreshLunchHud();
   setMsg('★ БЕСКОНЕЧНАЯ СМЕНА! Комикс завершён — продолжаем играть на рекорд.');
 }
 updateUI();
 if(typeof finishedCallback==='function')finishedCallback();
}
function storyAdvance(){
 if(!storyStage)return;
 const scene=STORY_SCENES[storyStage];
 storyClearTimer();
 if(storyStep>=scene.rects.length-1){storyFinish();return;}
 storyStep++;
 const frame=storyFrames[storyStep];if(frame)frame.classList.add('on');
 storyRefreshControls();
 storySchedule(storyStep===scene.rects.length-1?4600:3000);
}
function playStoryScene(stage,onDone=null){
 const scene=STORY_SCENES[stage];if(!scene)return;
 storyClearTimer();storyStage=stage;storyStep=-1;storyDone=onDone;
 lunchSceneActive=true;keys.clear();joy.active=false;joy.dx=joy.dy=0;
 $('storySceneName').textContent=scene.label;
 $('storyGhost').src=scene.art;
 const page=$('storyPage');page.querySelectorAll('.storyFrame').forEach(n=>n.remove());
 storyFrames=[];
 scene.rects.forEach((rect)=>{
   const [x,y,w,h]=rect;
   const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='storyFrame';
   box.style.left=(x/STORY_WIDTH*100)+'%';box.style.top=(y/STORY_HEIGHT*100)+'%';
   box.style.width=(w/STORY_WIDTH*100)+'%';box.style.height=(h/STORY_HEIGHT*100)+'%';
   const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=scene.art;img.draggable=false;img.alt='';
   storyCropImage(img,rect);box.appendChild(img);page.appendChild(box);storyFrames.push(box);
 });
 $('storyProgress').replaceChildren(...scene.rects.map(()=>{const i=document.createElement('span');i.className='storyTick';return i;}));
 $('storyCinematic').hidden=false;
 storyFitPage();storyRefreshControls();updateUI();
 storySchedule(300);
}
$('storyPage').addEventListener('click',storyAdvance);
$('storyNext').addEventListener('click',storyAdvance);
$('storySkip').addEventListener('click',storyFinish);
$('storyPage').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();storyAdvance();}});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
 if(!storyStage)return;
 if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key===' '||e.key==='Enter'){
   e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();storyAdvance();
 } else if(e.key==='Escape'){
   e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();storyFinish();
 }
},true);
window.addEventListener('resize',storyFitPage);
if(typeof ResizeObserver!=='undefined')storyPageResizeObserver=new ResizeObserver(()=>{if(storyStage)storyFitPage();});
